Feeling tired of being hard on yourself?
Longing for a quieter, softer moment in your day?
Self-Compassion Coloring Book for Adults was created to help you slow down, soften self-criticism, and reconnect with yourself through calming coloring pages and gentle affirmations.

Treat yourself — or someone you love — to a peaceful coloring experience and rediscover the beauty of being kind to yourself.
Click Buy Now and begin your journey toward more calm, softness, and self-compassion — one page at a time.

• Large format — 8.5 × 11 inches• 50 therapeutic coloring illustrations• Printed single-sided to help reduce bleed-through• Matte finish cover• 120 pages total

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Decent for the price, could use some improvementsDecent for the price, could use some improvements
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Decent coloring book for the price. I don’t regret getting it. Pages aren’t overly thin. I personally don’t like when coloring books have pictures on both sides of the pages, so I’m glad this one doesn’t. I like the quotes that are in it; I just personally would have liked to see more variety for the flowers /borders around the quote. Also, there is one that has a misspelling (pictured: “Moself” instead of “Myself”) & there’s not really a convenient way to color it in a way that hides the misspelling, so I’ll probably just skip that page. Gave it a 4 because overall not a bad product for the price, just some adjustments that could improve it.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Inner peace loading within this book of hilarious quotes and coloring pages.
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This book is filled with 40 coloring pages full of funny and interesting quotes. These quotes are not ones that you see or hear every day, but I can see me using them more now. I would suggest that you use bright vibrant colors that will calm and relax your inner thoughts as well as bring life and meaning to the pages. Rather you like floral patterns or maybe you like structured and balanced pictures this book is for you. The geometric designs will help calm your mind while the hilarious quotes will have you laughing while lifting up your spirits. "Inner peace loading" or "don't rush my Zen" would be a great title for this book. I also like ' cancel plans not dreams". I feel that this book is well suited for young adults and the older adults who need a good laugh and a sense of calming and relaxation.
